defs.def: an organized activity that involves several people doing different things （有组织的）活动，行动

ex.s: This marked one of the final stages of a top-secret operation that had been months, perhaps years, in the planning.
ex.t: 这标志着一项绝密行动的最后阶段之一，这项行动已经规划了数月，甚至可能是数年。

ex.s: Code-named “Operation Overlord”, it was the largest combined sea, air and land operation in history, the aim being to free north-west Europe from German occupation.
ex.t: 代号＂霸王行动＂，这是历史上最大规模的海陆空联合作战，目的是将西北欧从德国占领下解放出来。

ex.s: After waiting for the perfect combination of weather, moon and tides, the date for the start of Operation Overlord was set for 6 June.
ex.t: 在等待了天气、月亮和潮汐的完美组合之后，霸王行动的开始日期被定在了6月6日。

ex.s: These operations have enabled scientists (better understand) geographical and biological conditions deep under the oceans.
ex.t: 这些行动使科学家能够（更好地理解）深海的地理和生物条件。
